name: Marshall County
quote: *Student and Parents’ choice of paddling - Before any student is paddled, the guardian must be contacted and a Corporal Punishment Permission Form must be on file in the office. NOTE - No student will be paddled more than twice during the school year.
notes: NCES-listed site www.mcs.k12.tn.us is dead (NXDOMAIN); live site found via DuckDuckGo (WebSearch quota was exhausted) is https://www.mcstn.net/. Primary source cited: 'MCHS Student Handbook 26-27' (Marshall County High School), fetched via the crew's fetch_document tool from Google Drive (uc?export=download, which redirects to drive.usercontent.google.com/download) -- 1,161,977 bytes, application/pdf, 29 pages, text extracted successfully (no OCR needed). Policy title 'Corporal Punishment - Policy 6.314' appears on p.11 ('Any principal, assistant principal or teacher with approval of the principal may use corporal punishment in a reasonable manner against any student for good cause...'); the operative consent procedure quoted above is on p.27 of the same document, in the MCHS discipline rubric. Classified consent_required (opt-IN), not allows, because paddling is only administered after the guardian is contacted AND a signed Corporal Punishment Permission Form is on file -- affirmative advance parental permission, per this project's opt-in rule. The district's official TSBA board policy manual (which would carry the policy's own adopted/revised dates) is hosted at https://tsba.net/marshall-county-board-of-education-policy-manual/, which links out to tsbanet.sharepoint.com Word/PDF files for each policy including 6.314; both the fetch_document tool and a direct curl of those SharePoint links redirect to login.microsoftonline.com (Microsoft org auth wall) and never returned document text (needs_ocr:true, text_chars:156, i.e. only the login page). So policy_adopted/policy_revised could not be sourced from the policy manual itself -- only the handbook's own 2026-2027 cover year is confirmed current. Next contributor: try opening the tsbanet.sharepoint.com 6.314 link in an authenticated/logged-in browser session to get the policy's own adoption/revision dates and full legal text. Contact fields are from mcstn.net's Board of Education and Contact Us pages (read 2026-09-20/21); no general district or board email is published on the site (only an unrelated Google Calendar address was found), so left null per the null-beats-a-guess rule.
